description: Choose which events a connected Amplitude integration records, without the webhook secret (reconnecting would replace the secret and stop deliveries until the destination is updated). syncAllEvents false plus eventAllowlist records only those types. skipInternalEvents (on for new connections) drops session, [Amplitude] autocapture, and other $ events unless allowlisted; identify always passes. Applies to later deliveries; dropped events are not replayed. Amplitude only. Requires the `integrations:manage` scope; otherwise use the dashboard (Settings -> Integrations -> Amplitude).

eventAllowlist.description: Amplitude event types to record when syncAllEvents is false, exactly as Amplitude names them. Replaces the saved list.

integrationId.description: Amplitude integration ID from list_integrations or get_integration.

skipInternalEvents.description: Skip session_start, session_end, [Amplitude] autocapture, and other $ events unless allowlisted.

syncAllEvents.description: true records every event type; false records only eventAllowlist.

eventSettings.description: The saved scope: { syncAllEvents, eventAllowlist, skipInternalEvents }.
